title: Relational Databases
incompatibilities: You are not able to enrol in this course if you have successfully completed COMP2400 . Incompatible with COMP7240 .
requisite_raw: You are not able to enrol in this course if you have successfully completed COMP2400 . Incompatible with COMP7240 .
description: This course is an introduction to relational databases and the general skills for designing and using them. The topics include the relational data model, SQL, entity-relationship model,functional dependencies,(de-)normalisation, relational algebra, query processing and optimisation, database transactions and security. To deepen the understanding of relational databases, the current industry development of database systems such as NoSQL databases will be introduced at the end of this course.
learning_outcomes: Describe the basic concepts of the relational model and understand its mathematical foundation;
Connect database design with social and economic impacts including security, ethics, and Australian Privacy Principles.
Use SQL to define, query and manipulate a relational database, and describe principles of SQL query processing and optimisation.
Use data modelling concepts and practices to create, evaluate and communicate relational database designs, collaboratively and individually.
Compare the relational data model with alternative models.
